sample_dialogue: Вы только вдумайтесь. Прошли миллионы лет эволюции, а женщины так и не научились получать оргазм за полторы минуты.
performance_prompt: Native Russian male, 40–45. Medium-low, slightly muted, dry and lived-in voice with subtle smoky roughness. Clear, natural and unpolished. Speak at a compact normal conversational pace, seriously and matter-of-factly, as if sharing an interesting fact with someone nearby. Use only tiny natural pauses. Never theatrical, polished, excited, sleepy, slow, funny, or announcer-like. Do not signal the punchline.
